resonator.honest: All four are older units, a step below 3.8's top teams. This convene is for completing a team you already run — not for chasing power.
resonator.mechanics: Pick one target and change it at any time. Your pick is a 50/50, like a featured banner: lose it and the next 5★ is guaranteed to be your pick. Pity and the guarantee are shared only with other Reverb Resonator convenes — never the featured banners — and carry over to future Reverb events.
resonator.name: Starpath Reverbs II

pool.name: Phoebe
pool.reason: Phoebe stacks the Spectro Frazzle that Zani's biggest damage cashes in. She is the partner Zani's kit is built around.

pool.name: Brant
pool.reason: Brant is Lupa's Fusion partner — he heals, shields, and hands out the Fusion boosts her kit runs on.

pool.name: Camellya
pool.reason: The self-sufficient pick: a complete Havoc main DPS who needs nobody else in this pool to work.

pool.name: Roccia
pool.reason: Roccia groups enemies and boosts Havoc damage — Phrolova's clearest partner in this pool. Only take her for a carry you already own.

resonator.tagline: Reverb Resonator Convene — you choose the featured 5★

weapon.honest: Only pull here if you own the Resonator and play them often — a signature weapon is a smaller upgrade than a new character for most accounts.
weapon.mechanics: Pick one weapon and change it at any time. The weapon you pick is guaranteed within 80 pulls — there is no 50/50 to lose. Pity is shared only with other Reverb Weapon convenes.
weapon.name: Tideforge Reverbs II
weapon.tagline: Reverb Weapon Convene — you choose the featured weapon
